statement: Pinned Cemu's Wiimote HIDAPI backend uses SDL3 HID enumeration for Nintendo vendor 0x057e and accepts product 0x0306 or 0x0330, excluding an explicit Wii U Pro product string, then opens the path nonblocking for native Wii HID I/O. The HIDAPI filter does not expressly require a physical Bluetooth connection or check bus type; a matching accessible UHID-Bluetooth hidraw endpoint is a candidate even while hid-wiimote binds, but this does not prove Cemu can initialize it. A uinput-only event device cannot satisfy HIDAPI enumeration.

applicability.revision: Pinned software consumer; retail Wii Remote revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer; Cemu 29f2f1f; HidapiWiimote.cpp 5-46, WiimoteControllerProvider.cpp 178-200. SDL3 HIDAPI and Linux permissions are required; possible kernel register contention.
